correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md identifies J_N=B_N*B_N with upper bidiagonal B_N=sqrt(t)I+shift, strictly positive for t>0. The three-term characteristic-polynomial recurrence gives det(J_N−I)=t^(N−1)(t−N). Infinite displaced number-operator min-max plus strict interlacing puts all nonminimal eigenvalues >1, so determinant sign fixes exact bottom crossing including N=1. Explicit B_N inverse gives trace J_N^−1=N!/t^N ∑_{k=0}^{N−1}t^k/(k!(N−k)). For t=rho N< N, Poisson Chernoff/Taylor gives the sharp (1−rho) prefactor, and other inverse eigenvalues contribute at most O(log N); for rho>1 shift norm lower bound and sine-arch trial vector give (sqrt(rho)−1)^2. Independently checked 27 symbolic matrix cases N=1..9, t=1,4,9; no critical-window claim is made.
